name: Wynn
self_text: With a background in history, I've recently turned my attention to programming. I find that I get the most out of a step-by-step walkthrough session. I'm happy to meet in person, and most weeks I can do Saturday morning or weekday evenings. When I'm not at the screen, I spend my time woodworking, which I love for the tactile sense of creation.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into programming and you have to be into a step-by-step walkthrough session. I'd strongly prefer that you are available either Saturday morning or weekday evenings, though it's not a requirement. It would be a small bonus if we overlap on in person.
